digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter family seam and Data Center backend
propositions: rebar cannot reconcile against self-hosted Jira Data Center because it supports only Cloud REST v3/ADF/accountId, while DC uses REST v2/wiki-markup/name identities and Personal Access Token auth
PR #120 proposed a second adapter that forked six internal units from adapters/jira/, creating duplicated field maps and shared logic with no enforced contract, risking drift when Cloud changes

location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) are loaded by file path and cannot relocate without breaking the dynamic loader, requiring dependency inversion rather than relocation to share logic

three independent copies of the local-to-Jira status and priority maps exist in adapters/jira/jira_fields.py, adapters/jira/outbound_fields.py, and rebar_reconciler/config.py, and have already drifted on the 'deleted' key
the rich-text codec and user-identity model must support two implementations (ADF+accountId for Cloud, wiki/plain-text+name for DC) unified by a single shared contract, not a single implementation

a self-hosted DC instance serving over HTTP or with self-signed certificates presents security risks that require explicit TLS enforcement with configurable CA bundles and deliberate insecure overrides, never silent disablement of certificate verification
